content: {"episode_id":"ep-05082","cpt":"93271","denial_carc":"CO-97","necessity_paragraph":"We appeal the CO-97 denial of CPT 93271 based on the documented clinical indication for cardiac event monitoring. The patient has recurrent transient neurological deficits and palpitations with a personal history of transient ischemic attack and cerebral infarction. Echocardiographic findings confirm nonrheumatic mitral valve insufficiency, raising concern for potential atrial arrhythmias contributing to embolic risk. Cardiac event monitoring was ordered to correlate these symptoms with underlying rhythm disturbances."}
